description: Wiley X Enzo High Rx Prescription Wrap Motorcycle Glasses The Wiley X Enzo will make you the most stylish rider on the road. This motorcycle style wraps very closely around the face and blocks out light from every direction. The Enzo High Rx prescription glasses features a snap-in High Rx Rim. Patients with a sphere power over + /- 3.50 may experience the fish bowl effect when wearing the Enzo without the Rx Adapter. The Rx Adapter system flattens out the curvature of each lens. As a result, the frame can accommodate high power prescription lenses while maintaining the quality of the optics. Wiley X Enzo High Prescription Frames Protects You From the Elements This motorcycle wrap style has unnoticeable rubber inside of the temples that help keep your glasses secure during moments of intense activity. description: Spoiler Photochromic Day Night Motorcycle Glasses The Spoiler Photochromic Day Night Motorcycle Glasses features a flexible light weight frame. Rectangular design gives you a lot of attitude. Lens are good size and provide excellent protection and peripheral vision. Or choose lenses that change from yellow to rustic brown. Yellow lenses help eliminate the “halo effect” around lights at night. FOAM PADDED PROTECTION: Removable sweatproof foam cushion protects your eyes from wind, dust, and debris while you are riding your motorcycle. IMPACT RESISTANT POLYCARBONATE LENSES: When shopping for sunglasses, eye protection should always be a priority. These frames can fit larger head sizes. 180 WRAP PROTECTION: Blocks UV rays, wind and debris from all angles. Wrap lenses also filter out UV rays that bounce off the inside of your lenses if the sun is behind you. Wrap sunglasses keep your eyes comfortable and safe. Great for cycling, runniig, motorcycle and convertibles.
